timestamp_derivation: After the historical snapshot-artifact cleanup executed on the appliance and the coverage fix was proven on a disposable PG16; before the author timestamp of the commit that introduces this receipt. Per T0091, in the order T0108 requires.

defect_found_by_live_verification.what: Completeness was measured by counting rooms in ADMITTED stay_events. The connector fix stopped admitting vacant-room GO records, which are exactly the ones that made a sweep countable.
defect_found_by_live_verification.measured: generation 247 (before the fix) 439 occupied + 149 vacant = 587 rooms; generation 248 (after) 424 occupied + 0 vacant = 423 rooms.
defect_found_by_live_verification.effect: pms_roster_reconcile refused REFUSED_ROSTER_INCOMPLETE permanently. Fail-safe -- it closed nothing and no guest was affected -- but the feature could never enable.
defect_found_by_live_verification.cause: Inferring the OBSERVATION from the ADMISSION. What the connector sees is the building; what it admits is only the part that keys a Stay.
defect_found_by_live_verification.fix: pmsd records what each completed sweep observed (distinct rooms named, occupied records, vacant rooms seen and deliberately refused) via iam_v2.pms_record_resync_coverage, and reconciliation reads that instead of counting events.
defect_found_by_live_verification.rejected_alternative: Re-admitting vacant-room GO records would restore the count and reopen the 14 125-record defect. Coverage is evidence about a sweep, stored as one row per generation with no stay, no event and no guest.

automatic_operation.trigger: pmsd records coverage and runs reconciliation immediately after publishing a complete generation. There is no button, no queue and no flag.
automatic_operation.deferral: Neither step can fail the sync. A refusal or an error is logged and the NEXT complete sweep retries, which is the entire deferral mechanism: a property that resyncs produces a fresh authoritative generation every time.
automatic_operation.new_outcome: REFUSED_NO_COVERAGE_EVIDENCE names the one honest gap -- every generation from before this migration has no observation and never will, so reconciliation defers until the first sweep that does.

historical_cleanup_executed.history_preserved: 70 830 stay_events unchanged; 13 717 rows remain MANUAL_REVIEW exactly as written. Nothing was deleted and no stay changed state. The dispositions are APPENDED alongside.
historical_cleanup_executed.genuinely_unresolved: ONE case: a LIVE Guest-Out of 2026-08-23 11:46:15 that carried a reservation number the mirror holds no stay for (GO_UNKNOWN_STAY). It is answerable only by the PMS, and it is left on the list rather than hidden.
